criterion: Form S, both sets mandatory: delta_wF1(D-C) >= MCID 0.050 AND lower 95% CI bound > 0

interpretation.operative_form: External clinical performance. On both external clinical sets — different hardware, different population, no retraining — the integrated configuration delivers absolute weighted F1 higher than baseline by a clinically meaningful margin, with intervals excluding zero: +0.0689 (p=0.0021) on IDRiD and +0.0541 (p=0.0138) on Messidor-2. Sum PASS = 2 = N, so h7_supported = true.
interpretation.not_aggregated: The sets are scored separately: a single reversal (upper CI bound < 0) on either would give REVERSED regardless of the other.
interpretation.thin_margin: On Messidor-2 the margin over the MCID is only 0.0041 and the lower CI bound (+0.0362) sits below the threshold. That is legitimate under form S — which requires delta >= MCID AND CI- > 0, not CI- >= MCID — but the pass must not be presented as comfortable.
interpretation.why_delta_drop_was_retired: Delta_drop(D) - Delta_drop(C) is identically Delta_in_domain - Delta_external = 0.0655 - delta_wF1(X). Its sign is fixed by whether the external margin exceeds the in-domain margin, so the criterion demands that the pipeline beat baseline more on foreign data than on its own, and penalizes it precisely for its in-domain win. It measures nothing about resistance. Verified on both sets: IDRiD 0.0655 - 0.0689 = -0.0034; Messidor-2 0.0655 - 0.0541 = +0.0114.
interpretation.what_must_not_be_claimed: Reduced degradation. Once normalized by each arm's own in-domain level the structural skew almost vanishes: 21.2% vs 19.1% on IDRiD, 16.7% vs 16.7% on Messidor-2.
interpretation.same_defect_elsewhere: The identical normalization defect drives the g_ratio inversions in Experiment 6 (H-6), so one argument covers both metrics.

caveats: Evaluated from fold-0 checkpoints; no between-fold variance.
The same two datasets appear in Experiment 6 as the camera groups kowa_idrid and topcon_messidor2 — the numbers are identical by construction.
